description: A traceable, updateable direct systems port of FrankenTUI into .NET 10. Source-language API identity is not required; observable behavior, terminal effects, failure and cleanup behavior, determinism, declared realization, host behavior, and operational constraints are.

settings.interface: Every in-scope upstream crate/module/screen/tool has a traceable .NET project/file/surface; the public .NET facade may be idiomatic rather than Rust-API-identical.
settings.result: Use exact bytes, cells, snapshots, hashes, schemas, or values where the source defines them; otherwise require materially matching user-visible structure and behavior with a named divergence.
settings.effects: Preserve state transitions, mutation/ownership consequences, terminal control sequences, one-writer routing, host modes, and teardown effects.
settings.failure: Preserve rejection conditions, failure timing, cancellation and cleanup obligations, translating error types explicitly where runtimes differ.
settings.determinism: A pinned basis, seed, input tape, viewport, policy, and host context must produce replayable buffers, evidence, and decisions.
settings.realization: Record native, wrapper, delegated, fallback, unsupported, or unknown realization separately from public surface coverage.
settings.operational: .NET 10 only, dependency-light, NativeAOT-conscious, cross-platform, and performance-sensitive without weakening strict behavior.
settings.deviationPolicy: Every non-isomorphic or host-driven difference is local, named, justified, tested, and reviewable.
settings.upstreamPolicy: Track upstream main and reconcile every source-basis advance before claiming current preservation.
